# Research Review Template

**Location:** `docs/templates/RESEARCH_REVIEW_TEMPLATE.md`
**Governed by:** §11.4.5, §12.2, §12.3

## Purpose

Standardized format for scientific and technical research records (§11.4.5). Preserves sources, assumptions, limitations, and unresolved questions (§12.2.10).

## Instructions

- Distinguish confirmed findings from assumptions and unresolved uncertainty (§13.1.3).
- Record why each question remains unresolved and when it should be revisited (§13.1.2).
- Research findings must be available in appropriate project documentation before transition to implementation (§12.7.1).

## Template

```
# REVIEW-XXX — [Research Topic]

**Record ID:** REVIEW-XXX
**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Researcher:** AI Development Partner
**Type:** Scientific research | Technical research | Feasibility assessment

## Research Question

What question or topic was investigated?

## Sources Consulted

List all sources examined (Foundation sections, external literature, libraries, archives, etc.):
- Source 1: [title, location, relevance]
- Source 2: [title, location, relevance]

## Findings

Summarize confirmed findings. Distinguish verified facts from assumptions (§10.9.9).

## Assumptions

List assumptions made during this research. Identify which are verified and which remain unverified.

## Limitations

Identify limitations of the findings — gaps in data, unavailable benchmarks, unclear methodology, etc.

## Unresolved Questions

| Question | Why unresolved | Revisit condition |
|---|---|---|
| | | |

## Recommendation

What does the AI recommend based on this research, and why?

## Related Records

- Related decisions: [DEC-XXX references]
- Related problem records: [PROB-XXX references]
- Related test reports: [TEST-XXX references]
```
